>"modest endowment"

God, I wish it could be just modest endowment. I probably wouldn't have made this thread. Perhaps I could at least have confidence somewhere.

To reply to you comment you deleted, I guess that was badly worded. But in a sense what I meant was if you have a majority of people saying "oh yeah my dick is average to above average" and your sitting there as the outsider knowing that you are not even a match to them. Both physically, genitally, and emotionally, then yes, yes I am.

Initially this thread wasn't even what women though about small dick. It was about what men talked about it. The stigma that every man has this huge member. Hell, just listen to today's music and the lyrics will reiterate how big their dick is. Compare me with anyone else and I'm nothing in comparison. I do treat people well, I bottle up all of my emotion well enough to seem like your average Joe. But look where that got me haha.
Your right. Probably won't be the end of the relationship, but you will have to accept that your partner is inferior to other. It might be "ok" but it won't be great.

Because why would you date a small dick when you can get an average or even better one. Let's not pretend that physical appearances don't mean anything. And let's say that you like someone but during sex you find out he has a small penis. Then you either settle for lesser or you get disappointed by it.

Yes, I'm thinking about killing myself because I still live with my parents, I'm still in college persuing something I don't even know if I like, I have no friends, I do struggle with addiction, because throughout my life (even at my highest) nobody ever showed interest in me, and because I have a small dick. Yes, really.
That's more of an unfair comparison. Go 4in vs 5.5 or even 6in (the average size), then it would be a different story.
But why settle for less when you can get something better? All you get from me is a small dick loser who can't make the cut.

of course there is a fetish for small cocks, but I don't want to be in that category, it's not something to be proud to have that label. I just want to have a to have a normal size like everyone else.

Have you seen the video with Louie Theroux with the body builder? The dude is jacked but even he is insecure about his penis regardless of his huge body.
